activeSessions.hint: Where your account is signed in. Sign out everywhere else if you see something you don't recognise.

tagEditor.empty: No tags yet. Add a tag from any task and it'll show up here to rename, recolour, or remove.

assistant.remindersHelp: When on, the reminder sent before a planned task starts is written by the assistant — a short, personalised nudge instead of the standard template. The reminder buttons (snooze, mark done) work either way.

labels.categoriesHint: Post-it colour on the board. Every task belongs to one.
labels.tagsHint: Washi-tape labels a task can carry several of. Rename, recolour, or remove them.

override.body: Planning {{week}} from scratch starts a new session that will replace the existing plan when you finalise it. Revise the current plan instead to keep what's already scheduled.
